lede: October FOMC minutes showed nearly all officials expect further rate rises, and Governor Waller floated a half-point move in December, keeping the dollar index near a 19-month high. Gold suffered its steepest drop in months to the lowest level since September 2025, while Bitcoin slipped below its 200-week average.
snapshot_time: NY close Wed 18 Nov · XAUUSD & Brent ≈07:00 TRT

focus.text: Down another 0.5% near $3,708 after Wednesday's ~3.5% slide on hawkish minutes and a firm dollar. Today: US jobless claims and Philly Fed at 16:30 TRT.
Holding just under 1.10 at 19-month lows as Fed–ECB policy divergence widens. Today: US claims/Philly Fed at 16:30 TRT and ECB President Lagarde remarks.

technicals.note: Gold has broken its uptrend line from 2023 and trades beneath the whole daily Bollinger envelope, with 3,700 marking the 50% retracement of the 2023 advance.
A third straight week of lower highs has pushed the pair below the 1.10 handle, which now caps the first rebound attempts.

calendar.event: Employment change (Oct): −43.5k vs +25k exp; jobless rate 4.9%

news.text: October minutes showed almost all officials see more hikes as likely needed; Waller floated 50bp for 9 Dec. Markets price ~90% odds of at least 25bp.
Gold fell about 3.5% on Wednesday to its weakest since September 2025, with silver down roughly 5% near $45; the dollar index hit ~103.8.
Dow lost 1.1% and the S&P 500 fell a fifth day; Nvidia dropped 2.9% despite beating forecasts. Anthropic priced its IPO at $83, above range.
WTI slid 3.2% after a larger-than-expected US crude build, outweighing renewed Strait of Hormuz tension; Brent held near $92.
UK CPI rose to 3.6% as expected, below the BoE's 3.7% call, trimming Dec hike odds to ~80%. Australia shed 43.5k jobs; unemployment hit 4.9%.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $239.9m of net outflows on Tuesday, $209.5m from BlackRock's IBIT; November redemptions total roughly $2.6bn.
Bitcoin dipped below its 200-week moving average for the second time this year after the Fed minutes; the Fear & Greed gauge sits near 10.
XRP and SOL edged higher while ETH lost the $1,800 mark. Solana ETFs logged their first inflow in 24 days ($11.6m); XRP funds saw $6.1m out.
Polygon plans a $50–100m push to buy payment companies and secure licences worldwide, deepening its payments focus.
Kraken parent Payward agreed to acquire Tribe Capital, which manages about $2.6bn; closing is expected in Q1 2027.
LayerZero (ZRO) unlocks ~3.7% of circulating supply on Friday; AKE releases ~9.4% on Saturday.
